issues.description: Reviews report being unable to access an account or having a password rejected.
Reviews object to features such as choosing, skipping, or queuing songs being restricted to Premium.
Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, changing recommendations, and limited music selection.
Reviews report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.
Reviews express general dissatisfaction with the app without describing a specific problem.
Reviews report playback interruptions, connection trouble, crashes, loading failures, and malfunctioning music adjustment.
A review expresses dissatisfaction with the app's support team.
Reviews mention frequent ads, unwanted shuffle behavior, removed player features, and difficulty navigating playlists or albums.
